reason: The artifact under test was never wrong. The fixture was. job-emitted/ is a REJECTED job with logger times: its record says job_id 'fixture-rejected' and retention.location 'tests/fixtures/custody/job-rejected', and it carries a D2 violation -- 'The Risks section the brief names is empty.' The emitter correctly writes verdict=reject, terminal_state=rejected. Four validate_schemas cases that assert a CLEAN written record therefore cannot pass on this fixture by any repointing; the fixture is the defect, not the harness, not the emitter, not an assertion.

6f2a50e -- clean_emitter_tree() in tests/test_plumbline_verify.py copied a TYPED LIST of three kit modules while the emitter imported a fourth sibling (kit/evaluator_harness_log.py); the copied tree exited 1 where the test expected 3. Now copies the whole kit/ directory derived from the listing.

04b4ecf -- copy_job() copied the refusal fixture, so the V3 and V5 cases in tests/test_plumbline_verify.py were handed a job whose harness log carries no logger times and the emitter refused it under D6/D7. Both cases assert that a record IS written and what it says, so they keep that meaning and take job-emitted. No assertion changed. Class (a) under the Owner's decision rule, NOT standard_moved.

The runtime-stamping mechanism is gone from tests/validate_schemas.py -- _stamp_logger_times, LOGGED, logger_stamped, job_copy_logged and job_copy_raw were removed by the Maker's generation 1 (b2442a9); emitted_copy() exists and every emit-path case already calls it, including the 59 s case, T3, E2 and T2c. Step 6 was already complete when it was authorised; there was nothing left to repoint.

correction_recorded: The Owner's superseding charge ('do not re-derive the fixture') arrived AFTER the real-record derivation had run, and it HAD overwritten job-emitted/. The work was stopped, the tree restored to 04b4ecf with git checkout, and the ten stray paths the copy left were removed -- all under tests/fixtures/custody/job-emitted/, nothing outside it. git status clean at 0 changes; the pushed sha is the fixture the Owner ordered kept. Recorded as the correct handling of a withdrawn order.
fixture_kept: job-emitted/ is NOT reverted. It is wrong as an emit fixture, but it is a true fixture of a rejected job with stamped times and the bar's shape checks pass on it. It is superseded by Job 9, not deleted.
standing_limitation: run-aider is a diff editor over tracked files. It cannot create a tree. Two Maker generations (gen 1 partial, gen 2 empty) failed on the tool, not the design. A fixture tree must be authored by the Architect (instruments) or derived from a real record; no Maker generation can build one.
known_conditions_for_the_next_job: A test that copies a subset of the implementation is a test that silently stops covering the module it forgot. Third harness-not-artifact defect of the night; both copies are now directory-derived.
A bar that shells out to the emitter is green only on a COMMITTED tree -- and staged is not clean, only committed is. Measured: 10/12 uncommitted, 10/12 staged, 12/12 committed.

An emit fixture must represent a job that PASSED. Assembling one from a rejected job plus stamped times produces a fixture that emits a rejected record, and every clean-record assertion fails against it while the harness looks correct.
